name: Murder at the Manor
description: A guest lies dead at the manor. Each suspect was in a different room with a different motive. Work out whodunit.
clues: If Gardening goes with Lounge, then Grimsby goes with Veranda.

Either Ballroom goes with Sleeping, or Lounge goes with Writing — but not both.
